matches=[]
for line in sys.stdin:
 p=line.rstrip("\n")
 try:
  if not os.path.isfile(p) or os.path.islink(p):continue

  if (v.get("status")=="pinned_ack" and int(v.get("chatId",0))==-1002373696859
      and int(v.get("threadId",0))==4640
      and str(v.get("botUsername","")).lower()=="createvdobot"
      and int(v.get("botId",0))>0 and int(v.get("messageId",0))>0):
   matches.append((p,int(v["botId"]),int(v["messageId"])))
 except (OSError,ValueError,TypeError,KeyError,json.JSONDecodeError):continue
if not matches:sys.exit(66)
if len(set((bot,msg) for _,bot,msg in matches))!=1:sys.exit(67)
paths=sorted((path for path,_,_ in matches),key=lambda p:(len(p),p))
print(paths[0])

import pg from 'pg';import{readFileSync}from'node:fs';
